lines: 1. Adi tingsaeng tucho aniu kandi ringhmei tingmik hei?
Neihlamei munpuang tuaidat lak khe;
Aniu hei ntam dat khang tingmik kathan patdat puni,
Tam dat makpui ram gaimei tei ning e.
Ntam makmei samei ram gaimei khou,
Zianmei nun le mbaan thaini;
Gaekloumei Guangh Khrista kanloumeipu,
Neihlamei hu khou rianramei tei maan ni.
2. Kandi ram hei khou hei kapma huaina rianra bamsini,
Rianramei paeng khou ram gaimei nai;
Kanloumei Guangh Khrista thei lai khou
Rianra loumei guaimu, Hei ram gai khou tei aniuni lungni.
3. Neihlamei munpuang bam, kanloumei Pu Khrista bampui ram,
Zaulo! Ai tingmik thui ning bam e;
Tingkao latdiu nun le nzianmei ntam kanmei guai le,
Tabui nung neihla na kariuni cho?
4. He! Nzianmei nun le, kataan taanv khang tei alieo mak na,
Kagan hei tingmik thui na guang the,
Lauthuan gaanphiu gaan gaimei tei guang khang tingmik hei ‘na the,
Taan hei taanluai pukhou mbaan thaini.
5. He! Pou’ kalloumeipu
Neihlamei munpuang gaimei Nang e,
Kandi neihlamei munpuang tuai the;
Nang zau khou tei he! Pou’ neihlamei tuang kapumma patdiu,
Neihlamei Sharon mun gai tei nang e.
